deepseek.prompt:
Create the reproducible four-pose sprite source sheet for one two-head-tall desktop pet, matching the approved current front design in image 1. Image 1 establishes all current facial features, exact identity, costume, colors, head and body proportions, and hand-drawn style. Image 2 is the old sprite sheet used ONLY for the exact layout, the rotation viewpoints, pose geometry, stance and character heights. Redraw all poses to use the updated design in image 1.

A single ultra-wide 3:1 row of exactly four distinct complete bodies, evenly spaced with large empty clear gaps and transparent outer margins. Left to right: (1) true frontal standing in the approved pose looking straight at viewer; (2) true 90-degree LEFT-facing standing profile with eyes aligned with nose, avoiding a three-quarter pose; (3) strictly symmetrical rear camera, no face, both legs and rear costume visible; (4) true front hanging suspended from an invisible chest pivot with elbows flexed a little, forearms held forward/down, knees and toes drooping and feet slightly higher than standing. The hanging head remains frontal, looking directly at viewer. All three standing sprites are the same physical scale and feet line, torso and head widths stay consistent, hanging is slightly compact at the SAME physical scale. The individual leftmost to rightmost figures must not overlap or touch. Maintain the flat clean dark outlines and broad colors of the approved chibi. The PNG must have genuine alpha everywhere outside each character and no checkerboard, ground, shadow, hands holding the mascot, text, labels, props or decoration.

Navy blue whale maid. Preserve two fin ears, two small blue side bows, white whale-emblem apron, bright round blue eyes, cheek warmth, friendly face, one single tail with a clean split two-lobed navy whale fluke. The tail base is always behind the skirt. No fin growth anywhere else.
deepseek.expression: 表情亲近好奇，害羞和委屈也容易读出来。正面时双眼直视镜头。
